title: WP-IMP-B: extend work-package.schema.json with the governed planning fields (badf-implementation-plan -> IMPLEMENTED)
objective: Advance badf-implementation-plan DESIGNED -> IMPLEMENTED by extending schemas/work-package.schema.json with the ten governed planning fields (source_baselines, expected_surfaces, authority_requirement, risk_factors, dependencies with typed edges, test_obligations, evidence_obligations, execution_budget, stop_conditions, composition) as OPTIONAL properties, and documenting the two external_target keys reconcile_work_package writes (landed_content_tree, composition_verified). Strictly additive and backward-compatible so all 76 existing WP records still validate. The schema walker enforces enum/pattern/nested-required; the type/coverage/authority/DAG controls are WP-IMP-C code controls (#171 / GOV-0071). No new gate command, no lifecycle change.
business_value: The Governed Work Package is the bounded execution contract; giving it a schema shape for the planning fields makes those fields governed rather than ad-hoc extras, so WP-IMP-C can enforce them and an authority can weigh them. Doing it backward-compatibly keeps the entire ledger valid -- validate_repo checks every WP record against the schema on every run, in the composed world too.
in_scope: schemas/work-package.schema.json: +10 optional planning fields + external_target landed_content_tree/composition_verified docs; no required change, no additionalProperties tightening
examples/work-package-planned.json: a planned WP exercising every new field

any new gate command, lifecycle.json change, scripts/badf_implementation_plan.py; WP-IMP-D shadow / WP-IMP-E admission
